summary: President Duterte lifted the 2014 moratorium on oil and gas exploration in the West Philippine Sea, approving the Department of Energy's recommendation to allow service contractors Forum Energy and PXP Energy to resume activities; Energy Secretary Cusi described it as 'a unilateral action on our part'.
actors: President Rodrigo Duterte; Department of Energy; Secretary Alfonso Cusi; Presidential spokesman Harry Roque
reasoning: Authorising resource exploration in disputed waters is unilateral administration/resource development without confrontation; demonstrative.

sources.title: Duterte OKs resumption of energy projects in West Philippine Sea
sources.excerpt: President Duterte has lifted the moratorium on oil and gas explorations in the West Philippine Sea to allow service contractors Forum Energy Ltd. and PXP Energy Corp. to resume their activities in the area
